name: Object Segmentation
description: Tracks the subject on the clips a matte-needing plan names, with SAM 2 face-seeded from step 1.04's face boxes. Runs after the planning steps and segments ONLY those clips (the trigger is stated in step.py): subject_grades entries in color_grade_spec, and behind_subject_overlays segments resolved against a_roll/b_roll placement. A wanted clip with no face box is declined, never blob-seeded. Masks land as {area:segmentation}/{clip_id}_segmentation.json, where compile grounds subject grades and behind-subject composites through the Loader-matte path.

inputs.name: clip_catalog
inputs.description: State input: clip_catalog from step 1.02. The paths the trigger's clips resolve against.

inputs.name: temporal_index
inputs.description: State input: temporal_event_indices from step 1.04. OPTIONAL: the per-clip face_presence face boxes seed the tracker; a clip with no located box is declined rather than seeded on an arbitrary region. An explicit face_boxes_by_clip map wins where one arrives.

inputs.name: face_boxes_by_clip
inputs.description: Explicit clip_id to normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] first-frame face box map (issue #268). OPTIONAL: wins over temporal_index where present.

inputs.name: color_grade_spec
inputs.description: State input: color_grade_spec from step 5.01. OPTIONAL: its subject_grades entries name clips to segment. Absent on runs with no subject-grade plan.

inputs.name: behind_subject_overlays
inputs.description: State input: behind_subject_overlays from step 4.06. OPTIONAL: each segment's timeline span resolves to placed picture clips through a_roll/b_roll. Absent on runs with no behind-subject plan.

inputs.name: a_roll_assignments
inputs.description: State input: a_roll_assignments from step 3.01. OPTIONAL: resolves behind_subject spans to source clips.

inputs.name: b_roll_assignments
inputs.description: State input: b_roll_assignments from step 3.02. OPTIONAL: resolves behind_subject spans over cutaways.

inputs.name: b_roll_interjections
inputs.description: State input: b_roll_interjections from step 3.02. OPTIONAL: resolves behind_subject spans over interjections.

outputs.name: object_segmentation
outputs.description: State output: per-clip segmentation results for the triggered clips

outputs.name: matte_trigger
outputs.description: State output: which clips the plans wanted mattes for and why, which segmented and which declined - the trigger stated on the run, not just in the module docstring.
